blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu—The Mandaue City government has terminated the services of 18 job-order (JO) personnel assigned to the Traffic Enforcement Agency of Mandaue (TEAM) office after they tested positive in a random drug test conducted on Tuesday, October 13. City Administrator Atty. Gonzalo Malig-on Jr. said in an interview on Monday, Oct. 19 that the personnel’s services were terminated effective Friday last week, Oct. 16. The decision followed a report from the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Office, which conducted the drug testing.
